title: Gantt bars
description: A plan on one axis: each row's bar grows from its start to its end when you name it, in its own colour, and a now line walks across the frame for the whole beat; what it has passed turns to full colour. Plain SVG.

props.items: 2-8 rows: {text: label, from: where the bar starts, to: where it ends (plain numbers on one axis), color, at}
props.lines: labels for the steps of the axis, from the first step on (optional)
props.stage: ground colour: a name from STAGE, any colour, or none
